method: Public pinned source and official protocol specifications; static analysis only; no deployment, installation, hosted onboarding or private data.

aweb.artifact_verification: Python research agent downloaded sdist, verified SHA256 against pinned uv.lock, copied .py/.sql only; contract researcher inspected those exact shared members.

schemas.name: server
invariants: Active project slug uniqueness separately for null tenant and each tenant; visibility public/private.
Repository unique(project,canonical_origin); soft-delete and resurrection preserve identity.

Active workspace alias unique within project. UUID, project, repo, alias, type ownership; trigger protects project/repo/alias/type immutability, timestamps and repo-delete lifecycle. Agent workspace requires repo; dashboard workspace forbids repo.
Claims unique(project,bead,workspace), not unique(project,bead); database permits multi-owner rows, ordinary writes enforce stronger exclusivity in claims.py.
Subscription uniqueness includes COALESCE(repo,''); array event types. Outbox has pending/processing/completed/failed states and attempts.
Policy versions unique(project,version); projects active_policy_id points to policy. FK cascade/set-null and partial indexes affect deletion semantics.

schemas.name: beads
invariants: Unique(project,repo,branch,bead). UUID identity; labels array; parent and cross-repo dependencies JSONB; creator/close attribution.
Cross-schema closed_by_workspace_id FK to server.workspaces SET NULL. pgcrypto UUID and pg_trgm GIN substring indexes; concurrent index migration outside transaction.

schemas.name: aweb
invariants: Active namespace/project/agent alias and DID uniqueness, namespace/project relationships; agent custody self/custodial, lifetime persistent/ephemeral, active/retired/deregistered status, encrypted signing_key_enc.

Mail message UUID, sender/recipient/project FKs, signatures/DIDs/thread/read_at; chat participant-set uniqueness(project,participant_hash), participant/read receipt composite keys, durable session messages.
Reservation PRIMARY KEY(project,resource_key), holder FK, acquired/expires timestamps and JSONB metadata; PostgreSQL state, not Redis.

Task counters allocate atomic next number via ON CONFLICT UPDATE RETURNING; unique(project,task_number); tasks status open/in_progress/closed, priority0..4, task/bug/feature; parent FK, dependency key+no-self check, comments FK; service checks dependency cycles via recursive SQL.
Policies version uniqueness and active pointer; durable controls signal type/consumed_at.

contracts.observation: Shared pgdbm PostgreSQL pool hosts server, beads and aweb schemas; embedded aweb migrations are applied under module aweb-aweb. BeadHub mounts its overrides before overlapping aweb routers (init, agents, GET claims, policies, status, GET tasks). aweb owns remaining auth, mail, chat, reservations, contacts, conversations and events.

POST /v1/bdh/command authenticates, binds actor, verifies live workspace and touches activity. It reads at most latest 200 project claims, resolves update in_progress/--claim IDs and rejects observed other-owner claims. It does not reserve or mutate claims. Unknown/ambiguous synced IDs resolve to no claim; same bead ID across repos is one project-level claim key.

Observed bdh first sends preflight; ordinarily explicit rejection blocks local execution. HTTP 410 aborts, identity mismatch retries init/key once; other HTTP/network errors warn and continue in local Beads mode. Auto-reserve is advisory. Successful bd mutation then exports JSONL and uploads sync; export failure can upload existing JSONL. No server rollback of local bd. Native mode without .beads uses authenticated /v1/tasks rather than bd and has no offline local task store.

Full mode requires nonempty JSONL and UPSERTS supplied issues; it is not replace-all deletion. Incremental carries changed issues and explicit deleted_ids. Branch is DEFAULT_BRANCH main. Upsert transaction locks existing row FOR UPDATE; rejects incoming updated_at only when both timestamps exist and incoming is strictly older. Equal/missing timestamps do not supply revision-CAS guarantees. Per-row conflicts retained for retry; no global atomic sync+claims+outbox transaction.

/sync applies issue upserts first, resolves IDs before deletions, applies deletions, then attempts claims for successful update in_progress. Each ordinary claim serializes(project,bead) via pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(...)) inside transaction; it rejects other workspace, replays own claim idempotently (created via xmax), then updates focus outside that claim transaction. Lost race returns claim_rejected in successful sync response after local issue changed. Close/delete/status leaving in_progress releases every workspace claim and recomputes focus. Claims have no TTL expiry.

Observed bdh --:jump-in requires reason, strips flag before command_line, bypasses client preflight/close rejection and best-effort sends mail intent even if bd failed. It does not transmit takeover permission; pinned /sync upsert_claim still rejects a second owner. Database multi-owner comment and docs do not prove server join/takeover capability. Reservation revoke is a separate API contract.

GET tasks merges legacy beads fallback with native task priority; inherited aweb owns task writes/dependencies/comments. A successful task status hook then tries BeadHub claim; conflict merely logs and returns, and cascade failures are caught. Native task write and server.bead_claims cannot be assumed atomic.

Project comes from verified aweb bearer details or signed internal wrapper context, never plain client project header. In direct mode enforce_actor_binding rejects differing non-null agent/workspace ID; scope/live workspace checks reject missing/deleted/foreign workspaces. /sync additionally resolves bearer lifecycle before mutations. Proxy v2 HMAC binds project/principal/actor; unsigned headers ignored when secret absent; wrapper owns actor binding. OSS init defaults ephemeral custodial agent, creates/ensures identity and mints key; shared secret wrapper is trust boundary, not public proof of SaaS authorization.

BeadHub presence HASH presence:workspace TTL actual default 1800s (comment says five minutes); project/repo/branch/global SET indexes and alias index TTL twice presence with lazy stale cleanup. Best-effort hooks clear presence. Redis fixed-window Lua INCR+EXPIRE init limit defaults 10/60s, fails closed 503 when unavailable. Redis Pub/Sub events:workspace are lossy signals, not durable event log or replay cursor. SSE reconnect/keepalive does not replay missed notifications.

Status changes commit before subscription notification intents are inserted separately. Outbox retries pending/failed at most 3, processes per-row FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED, calls aweb deliver_message via db_infra and then marks completed. No passed transaction/idempotency key proving exactly-once cross-schema delivery; crash gaps and duplicate risk must be considered. Audit logging best-effort. Per-project system sender deterministic UUID, alias system collision can fail notifications.

Server policy version allocation locks project row FOR UPDATE and max+1 with unique constraint; optional base_policy_id enforces active-policy optimistic concurrency. Preserve version/activation semantics or intentionally replace contract.

bdh autoreserve examines git status and optionally untracked files; locks use resource keys and metadata reason auto-reserve. Acquire conflict is 409 with holder/expiry; auto-reserve errors/conflicts warn, never prevent filesystem writes. Renew/release/revoke APIs separate from bead claims.

OSS frontend same-origin bearer transport uses local storage and can ingest aw_sk key from URL fragment then remove fragment. UI needs status/claims/workspaces+presence, tasks, escalation response, inbox/ack/send, chat/pending/history/admin and policy surfaces. api.ts references /v1/dashboard/config and identity absent among BeadHub-mounted routers: inherited/cloud availability must be proven rather than assuming complete hosted dashboard parity.

Generic origin canonicalizer supports git@host:path and scheme URLs, strips .git and ports, keeps host/path and nested GitLab groups. This is repository identity, not GitLab issue/MR/webhook/OAuth integration. No GitLab-specific tracker integration established by inspected server modules; native tasks and imported Beads are the implemented task sources.

REPOSITORY distinguishes BeadHub OSS composition, private beadhub-saas overlay and modern aweb ownership. Phase-0 recovery uses older aweb while rebasing; modern federation/AWID trust or hosted free-tier promises cannot establish pinned runtime behavior. Current modern docs say events are wake signals; durable mail/chat require state fetch and reconnect reconciliation; runtime process owner decides wake.

Exact 0.3.8 reservation state is PostgreSQL aweb.reservations. Acquire transaction SELECT FOR UPDATE; existing unexpired lease returns conflict even same holder, expired row replaced; PK arbitrates absent-row concurrent inserts (no absent-row lock guarantee). TTL clamped60..3600 seconds. Renew locks row, requires current holder and unexpired lease; missing/expired404, other409. Release missing/expired idempotent success, other holder409. Revoke only deletes caller-owned leases, optional prefix; no administrative takeover permission. Client comment force-releases is broader than actual server authorization. Expiry permits new acquisition, not task reassignment.

Exact 0.3.8 GET /v1/events/stream is PostgreSQL polling each1s, not BeadHub Redis Pub/Sub. Deadline required, max300s. Initial sweep mail unread50, chat participant messages50 since epoch (query does not consult read receipts), ready tasks10, assigned tasks50. Later polls timestamps/set diffs; no replay cursor or exactly-once event guarantee. Control signals persisted then UPDATE consumed_at before SSE at-most-once, so disconnect can lose signal. Mail/chat durable content remains authoritative.

Exact 0.3.8 mail and chat persist in PostgreSQL. deliver_message validates canonical sender alias and active same-project sender/recipient, INSERTs UUID (default random) with thread/signature metadata; route performs optional client-signed envelope handling or custodial sign-before-insert. Recipient-only ack sets read_at=COALESCE(read_at,NOW()) idempotently. Chat session participant hash deduplicates participant set; durable messages plus per-participant last_read_at. Redis chat:waiting:session ZSET timestamp scores,90s expiry and Lua atomic stale check/remove track connected waiters only, gracefully degrade false on Redis errors. aweb:presence:agent HASH TTL1800s and project SET index TTL2x distinct from BeadHub presence.

Exact aweb GET /claims is active task assignments, overridden by BeadHub GET claims; no aweb claim mutation router. update_task locks task row; in_progress autoassigns actor if unassigned, conflicts if current assignee differs. Explicit assignee updates separate from status are possible; no maintainer-only takeover policy established. Closing recursively closes descendants transactionally. Number allocator and task INSERT separate so gaps can occur. Mutation callback awaited then errors swallowed; cannot infer atomic BeadHub hook projection.

Pinned composition provides FastAPI OpenAPI plus explicit routes and BeadHub /mcp tools/list/resources/list; exact aweb0.3.8 source does not expose well-known capability/protocol_version discovery contract. bdh sync has explicit sync_protocol_version and retries full on mismatch, while server /sync response always1 and does not enforce incoming version. Old aw library has fixed endpoint methods and X-Latest-Client-Version observations, not modern AWID discovery proof.

migration_assessment.classification: Engineering inference from inspected contracts; no measured effort or dollar estimate.
migration_assessment.retain_postgres: Lowest semantic port cost: retain SQL transactions, migrations, JSONB/arrays, advisory/row locks and pgdbm pool; runtime hosting/driver qualification remains separate.
replace_postgres: Rewrite pgdbm migration/schema/table qualification, cross-schema joins/FKs/triggers/extensions, advisory/row locks, DISTINCT ON, ANY arrays, JSONB, timestamptz and xmin/xmax-dependent results.
Choose project ownership/partition boundary covering claims+task state; define transactions and idempotency for notification/mail instead of translating queries piecemeal.
Rebuild identity/key storage, lifecycle, durable mail/chat/ack/read, task numbering/deps/comments, policy versions and dashboard query projections from exact inherited aweb contracts.
replace_redis: Exact Redis replacement scope: BeadHub presence indexes/alias TTL, initialization fixed-window counter and Pub/Sub; embedded aweb presence HASH/index TTL and chat waiter ZSET/Lua. Reservation acquire/renew/release belongs to PostgreSQL replacement, not Redis.
Separate durable state from lossy event delivery. New transport may change clients; reconnect must re-fetch authoritative unread/state, and acknowledgements must not mean completed work.

bounded_new_contract_proposal.status: Proposed research option, not accepted implementation specification.
scope: Versioned discovery manifest declares capabilities/auth/event semantics; explicitly reject unsupported historical commands instead of silently claiming compatibility.

Authenticated actor and project derived server-side; explicit typed task mutation/claim/release requests with resource ID, expected revision and idempotency key; no command_line parsing or implicit alias authority.
Online claim transaction before externally coordinated work; local offline task edits may queue but cannot assert exclusive ownership. Represent post-mutation sync conflict honestly.
Explicit join versus transfer/takeover operation, reason and authorization; separate advisory file lease acquire/renew/release/revoke and TTL.
Durable mail/chat IDs, thread/conversation/read/ack semantics; event stream is lossy hint with reconnect snapshot; durable outbox and dedup/retry keys for delivery.
Retain canonical Git origin as optional reference; GitLab issue/MR operations are separate adapters requiring independently scoped authority.
Start minimal dashboard projection (team presence, claims, task, inbox/chat) and explicit unsupported hosted administration.

limits: Static source analysis, not running application/client conformance, installed client identity, deployment evidence, migration rehearsal or performance/cost measurement.
Server dependency declares >=0.3.8; uv.lock describes 0.3.8 reproducible composition only. Unlocked install can resolve a later aweb version.
Public bdh commit observed separately; BeadHub does not pin an exact bdh executable. Historical client compatibility is not assumed mandatory.

Automatic expiry reassignment, maintainer-only pre-expiry takeover and affected-scope quarantine after uncertain GitLab write are proposed policy decisions, not established upstream guarantees; root user questions remain open.
